The About page team cards are now centred: the round initials, the name and the role. I didn't open the rendered page or the diff images.

I added two rules in `site/css/pages.css`, both scoped to `.member` so other cards aren't affected:
- `.member .card-body` now has `text-align: center`, which centres the name and role.
- `.member .avatar` now has auto left and right margins. The avatar is a fixed 56px block, so it needs them to sit in the middle.

The visual tests show 10 snapshots unchanged and 2 changed: `about__desktop` (0.45% of pixels) and `about__phone` (1.09%). Both are style-only changes on the 16 team-card elements, which is what you asked for. The other five pages are unaffected.

I haven't approved the new baselines, since that needs your confirmation. If the change looks right, tell me and I'll approve both, or run `npx testivai approve about__desktop` and `npx testivai approve about__phone` yourself. I didn't run the functional tests.
